planning_notes: Board is explicitly arduino:avr:uno; wiring uses TM1637 CLK=D4 and DIO=D5, and button input on D2. No other pin overrides were supplied (empty supplied pins means no overrides).
When D2 is pressed, SysML drives tm1637_number to 1111; otherwise it drives 0000. The model handles the button-to-display logic; this proposal only registers the ports.
TM1637 invalid_policy is set to blank to avoid assuming any out-of-range display behavior beyond the specified catalog support.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display number controlled by D2 button
